verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a standard WebAuthn/FIDO2/U2F device that would work with any relying party supporting those standards (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, many password managers), and vendor docs confirm FIDO2/passkey and U2F-style support plus broad protocol coverage (OATH, PIV, OpenPGP). However there is no explicit first-party or independent testing evidence confirming compatibility with each named service, and a runtime probe shows the companion CLI tooling has bit-rotted with no firmware update in 4 years, raising doubts about ongoing maintenance/compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit per-service (Google/GitHub/Microsoft/password manager) compatibility confirmation, independent hands-on verification across these services, and evidence of active firmware maintenance to keep pace with protocol changes.
